lean.faithfulness_note: Lambda_q is the product of R_q and L_q over the unique R,L word of Lambda (Lemma 4(i) proved in Lean: existence and uniqueness). rho on L is fixed by the proved identity S_q R_q^-1 S_q^-1 = L_q. Generalisation: any positive Pell solution r^2-d s^2=1 (r,s,d>=1), not only the fundamental one. Only nonnegative Lambda is covered, so the write-up's Lemma 2 (symmetries) and Theorem 6 (general t) are not formalised and not needed. Divisibility is in Z[q,q^-1] (unit invariant, so 'up to monomials'). rho(Lambda) is defined up to a unit in the write-up; the statement is homogeneous so the representative is irrelevant.
lean.covers: For every positive Pell automorph, the R,L-word q-deformation Λ_q satisfies q(A-D)=(q-1)(qB+C) and C|B iff C|A-D in ℤ[q,q⁻¹].
